mentions.name: Multi-vendor Food Delivery System
mentions.description: A multi-vendor food delivery system built as a computer science final year project by a two-person team. The work was done without doing anything manually besides creating the entity relationship and briefly documenting the overall design system, and the system is currently about 80% complete with six months remaining.
